1. **Prominent longitudinal streaking** — alternating cream/white and slightly darker pale stripes running the full length of the leaf blades, parallel to the veins
2. **Extensive bleaching/whitening** of most leaf tissue
3. **Reddish-brown discoloration** at the stem base

**Class matching:**
- **Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv**: Hallmark is yellow-to-white streaks running parallel to leaf veins/midrib — the striped, longitudinal bleaching pattern I observe is the defining feature of this disease. Strongly matches.
- **Yellow_Leaf**: Primarily yellowing of the midrib underside spreading outward — less consistent with the striped/streaked pattern here.
- **Leaf_Scald**: Causes water-soaked stripes along leaf margins that dry to white/cream — possible, but the scald typically starts from margins inward, whereas the entire leaf appears uniformly streaked here.
- **Yellow_Spot**: Discrete oval spots — not matching the diffuse streaking pattern.

The longitudinal white/cream streaks running parallel to veins across entire leaves is the defining symptom of SCSMV streak mosaic. The severity (most leaves bleached) is consistent with advanced infection.
